mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate activity (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when HOUST declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS increases > 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and a high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.
